message.content: {"label":"sufficient","reason":"The passages collectively identify the exact competitors DoorDash cites in its Competition subsection: Uber Eats, Grubhub, Postmates, Domino’s, as well as broader competitive pressures from merchants’ own delivery, grocers, POS/merchant-delivery providers, offline ordering, and large internet companies like Amazon and Google. The required entities are explicitly named in the excerpted text.","supported_requirements":[{"requirement":"Uber Eats, Grubhub, and Postmates are named as competitors in US local food delivery logistics platforms.","passage_rank":1,"quote":"In the United States, we compete with other local food delivery logistics platforms including Uber Eats, Grubhub, and Postmates, chain merchants that have their own online ordering platforms, pizza companies, such as Domino’s, other merchants which own and operate their own delivery fleets, grocers and grocery delivery services, and companies that provide point of sale solutions and merchant delivery services."},{"requirement":"Domino’s is named as a competition (pizza company).","passage_rank":1,"quote":"...pizza companies, such as Domino’s, other merchants which own and operate their own delivery fleets, grocers and grocery delivery services, and companies that provide point of sale solutions and merchant delivery services."},{"requirement":"Other competition includes merchants’ own online ordering platforms, grocers and grocery delivery services, and POS/merchant-delivery providers.","passage_rank":1,"quote":"...chain merchants that have their own online ordering platforms, pizza companies, such as Domino’s, other merchants which own and operate their own delivery fleets, grocers and grocery delivery services, and companies that provide point of sale solutions and merchant delivery services."},{"requirement":"DoorDash expects competition from Amazon and Google as it expands into other verticals.","passage_rank":1,"quote":"With Drive, and as we expand into other industry verticals beyond food, we expect to compete with large Internet companies with substantial resources, users and brand power, such as Amazon and Google."}],"missing_requirements":[],"concerns":[]}
